title: Speech recognition fails or returns no partials
description: The ASR sidecar or managed ASR stops returning partial results or fails; safety signals must still be routable and the caller must reach a person.
callerVisible: The caller is asked to repeat once and then connected to a person; DTMF safety and human options stay available.
backendEvidence: ASR failure recorded on the turn
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:ASR_FAILURE] owned by WP-15 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the ASR sidecar or managed ASR fails or returns no partials

postconditions: Safety and human routes do not depend on ASR
No protected action proceeds on missing recognition
